title: Workspace lanes: micro-grid quick access for rollout telemetry
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a compact, keyboard-first workspace 'lanes' micro-grid that surfaces per-workspace rollout controls and telemetry summaries. This component is intended for the left rail replacement in the console and aims to reduce context switch time for platform engineers and PMs managing canary/A-B rollouts across Dedicated and Hosted models.
background: Current console sidebar mixes organizational navigation, project lists, and rollout controls. Frequent users report deep navigation to reach rollout dashboards and high cognitive load when switching between several active workspaces. We need a compact pattern that surfaces the most relevant rollout signals (status, errors, cost delta, active traffic %), while enabling fast workspace switching and canary actions without leaving the current view.
design_goals: Reduce time-to-action for rollout tasks (target 40% faster)
Expose rollout health and basic cost delta at a glance
Support keyboard-first navigation and quick actions (launch/rollback/cutover)
Scale visually for teams with 3–50 active workspaces without overwhelming the rail
Preserve accessibility and responsive behavior for narrow viewports
proposal_summary: Introduce a collapsible 'Workspace Lanes' micro-grid in the left rail. Each lane is a compact card representing a workspace; the card shows workspace name, an inline micro-thermometer for traffic %, a color-coded health dot (OK/Degraded/Critical), and a mini sparkline for cost delta over last 24h. Hover reveals primary rollout controls (Pause, Promote, Rollback). Keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+K then 1..9) focuses lanes; a single keystroke runs the primary action or opens the detailed rollout panel.
decisions: Use compact cards (44px height) to maximize vertical density while remaining tappable
Represent health as three-tier color system (green/yellow/red) with tooltip for details
Expose only primary rollout actions on hover/keyboard; advanced actions open rollout panel
Default sorting: pinned workspaces -> recently active -> alphabetical
Telemetry shown is an aggregated 24h window with links to full rollout dashboard
tradeoffs: We prioritize speed and glanceability over complete telemetry fidelity in the micro-grid; full metrics live in the rollout dashboard
Inline actions are limited to reduce accidental triggers; power users must open the rollout panel for complex operations
Higher density could reduce scannability for new users; explanatory onboarding will be required
review_feedback: PM feedback (Liam O'Connor): prefer a programmable keyboard palette for power users — add toggle to enable numeric quick-actions
Eng feedback (Sofia Martinez): backend needs an optimized endpoint that returns aggregated rollout+cost summaries per workspace — dependency noted (ENG-5789)
Accessibility review (Noah Green): ensure contrast ratios and focus outlines for compact cards; suggested increased hit target to 40px for touch devices
Design review (Aria Patel): prefer subtle motion for lane changes to help orientation when workspaces reorder
